verdict.rationale: Lighthouse documents an employer-facing service. Its Plus tier lists Compliance Support, Consolidated Billing, Candidate Progress Reports and workforce pathway strategy, and its hiring content says it 'handles the petitions, timelines, and compliance behind every hire.' Pricing also references USCIS fees varying by company size, which implies employer-sponsored filings. However, none of the evidence names the specific employer-side H-1B mechanics the story asks about. Missing for 10: explicit H-1B registration/lottery and transfer services, LCA filing/compliance (e.g., public access file) documentation, a detailed employer paperwork scope, and independent corroboration.
